summary: No mathematical errors or gaps were found. Checks of singleton profiles, endpoint centers, asymmetric zero-gap profiles, zero cutoff, cutoff ties, and lower-dimensional products yielded no counterexample. The product extension and canonical potential, pair gap, and full-occurrence capacities match accepted fact 488f0a583886b5fc. The stock identity, conditional Jensen and Cauchy-Schwarz bounds, Markov cutoff including g=0, disjoint endpoint-minimum packing, and threshold K(C)=16C are valid under the stated hypotheses.
